title: About
text:
Post-growth Futures collective is a grassroots organization where, through mutual aid, community organizing and art, we imagine a better future, or futures:

A future where we have enough for everyone
A future where we don’t need to fight for resources
A future where capital accumulation is not encouraged
A future where we share the gifts of nature and take care of the planet.

title: Notes
text:
Postgrowth futures is a grassroots organization that provides a platform for re-imagining the future beyond capitalism. Through Art, mutual aid and community organizing, we create spaces to connect, enable dialog, inspire, and re envision well-being.
Mission:
Connect local organizations to broader efforts (i.e. YCP to Degrowth CA)

title: The Cost of Growth
text:
Event description
“The cost of growth” is a film about how the struggles communities face against the extractive systems behind the global economy. After the screening, we hosted a potluck at the ecofarm with free food, art activities and music to keep the conversation about how does these themes relates to our community and beyond.
This event was part of a series organized in collaboration with Degrowth California and The North American Center for Postgroth Research

title: Postgrowth Futurism
text:
Postgrowth Futurism is a collective imagination card game that invites us to evoke a brighter future past the Capitalocene. By using storytelling and collective imagination, we aim to draw the connections between the pillars that uphold our current global economy and answer the question: What comes next?
Postgrowth futurism is a game for 1-6 participants played over 2 phases. In the case of having more than 8 participants, it is recommended to split the group into smaller groups so everyone in the group has enough time to participate. The estimated game time is 30-90 minutes.
Postgrowth futurism is inspired by the post-fossil futures workshop developed by otros futuros, the Doughnut economics action lab work, and the book Everything for Everyone: An Oral History Of The New York Commune.

title: Postgrowth Futurism
text:
I) Present (Storytelling)
It is important to place ourselves in the current reality we live. We all have different life experiences under the same systems of oppression. The first phase of the game is intended to explore this trough storytelling. For each round, the group will take turns on drawing a card from the Present deck.

title: Postgrowth Futurism
text:
II) Future (Collective imagination)
For the second part we will travel to the future. A future past all the current global crisis where we took a leap past the struggle. A future where we figured out the solutions to the biggest challenges we are currently facing, and our collective human needs are met. We will use collective imagination and world building to describe how that world looks like. If it helps, we can imagine how we got there, but most importantly, we will focus on how does it looks like and how does it feels. Participants are encouraged to build on each others responses and ask related questions to each other. During this stage of the game, participants are encouraged to reflect on what are the seeds for those future that exist today.
